rules.statement: When a script's comment-based help (such as `.SYNOPSIS`) names the workflows or scripts that run it, name every caller that actually runs it, each by its current file name.
rules.why: Help that names only one of several callers, or a renamed one, sends readers to the wrong workflow and causes the naming confusion renames are meant to remove.
rules.check: For a changed `.SYNOPSIS`/`.DESCRIPTION` that names a calling workflow, search the `.github/workflows` files (and any template workflows) for invocations of the script, and confirm the help names all of them by their current names.
